cause: Overlay repaint guard was installed only through focus::install/App::new; Files uses plain FLTK and installed the router only in its popup fixture. Production never registered the automatic guard.

before.initialization: plain FLTK, theme loaded, no focus router

fix: open_layer installs its own idempotent UI-thread pre-flush check, independent of keyboard runtime; focus check no longer owns overlay protection
limits: mapped framebuffer/internal handlers, not OS pointer proof
